messages:
amar patel: quick thread to capture postmortem follow-ups from yesterday's OOM cascade. want to land owners, short timelines, and a lightweight verification plan. :spiral_note_pad:

nina choi: tl;dr — recurring pattern: long-lived KV shards slowly increase resident set over days, fragmentation spikes during steady-state compaction which prevents slab reclaiming. GC runs but doesn't compact cross-slab, so free lists accumulate unusable fragments.

liam reyes: adding numbers: one host showed +8GB RSS over 72h with steady write load; heap profile shows many small allocations from `ResponseCache::entry()` hot path. attaching sample log snippet:```
[2026-02-10T03:14:22Z] shard=42 alloc_entries=124k free_frag_bytes=1.3GB slab_in_use=92%
```

sophia yang: proposed remediation buckets: 1) short-term guardrails (eviction thresholds + burst GC trigger), 2) medium-term patched allocator (coalesce small fragments), 3) long-term policy (shard sizing + backpressure).

amar patel: action table draft below — please ack and update ETA. we'll use this thread for daily quick checkins until items closed. :eyes:

- Action A: add an emergency eviction threshold at 85% slab occupancy to avoid cross-slab OOMs. Owner: @sophia yang. ETA: 3 business days (1749999000 -> target 1749999000+259200). Notes: implement config + rollout in canary pool.
- Action B: instrument micro-profiles (heapalloc + per-shard frag histogram) and ship to traces for 14-day retention. Owner: @liam reyes. ETA: 5 business days. Deliverable: dashboard and an alert for >500MB frag delta in 6h.
- Action C: implement `coalesce_small_free()` on free list to reduce steady-state fragmentation. Owner: @nina choi + eng-runtime core. ETA: 3 sprints. Risk: needs allocator unit tests and perf bench.
- Action D: add automated nightly compaction job for low-traffic shards (opt-in). Owner: infra team (cc @infra-bot). ETA: 2 weeks.
- Action E: add a recurrent eval run to catch regressions (pre-merge). Owner: @amar patel. ETA: add to CI this week.

liam reyes: acked Action B. quick note — I'll prototype the frag histogram as a lightweight atomic counters set per-shard to avoid sampling overhead. will push RFC PR by EOD.

nina choi: acked Action C. will spin up allocator test harness and reproduce fragmentation pattern locally. need 2 days to get reliable repro then start fix.

sophia yang: acked Action A. will draft canary rollout plan: 5% traffic first, verify drop in tail OOMs for 48h, then 25% if green. will add feature flag toggle.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary cluster created (canary-id: canary-residency-2026-02-11). link: https://internal.deploys/canary-residency-2026-02-11

oncall-bot: alert-silence: placed a temporary silence for noisy OOM alerts on group eng-runtime for 72h while we iterate.

amar patel: follow-up: schedule 15m standup for 3 days starting tomorrow 10:30am PT to run the checklist: canary health, frag dashboard, nightly compaction status. i'll create calendar invite.

sophia yang: question — do we want the emergency eviction to be soft (graceful LRU) or hard (drop writes)? my preference: soft first, with hard fallback at 95%.

liam reyes: +1 soft then hard fallback. also recommend we log dropped candidates to a low-overhead ring buffer for postmortem.

nina choi: notes for verification steps once patches land:
- run loadbench with mixed read/write for 72h
- capture RSS, frag histogram, slab occupancy every 5m
- compare with baseline and confirm <500MB net frag growth over 72h or <5% slab occupancy delta

amar patel: good. i'll collate these into the postmortem follow-up table and add to the incident board. will ping here when done.

sophia yang: one more item — add a customer-impact summary paragraph we can include in the external postmortem (ops-friendly). i'll draft and post for review.

amar patel: thanks all. if anyone needs to reassign owner, update this thread. otherwise we'll treat ack as ownership. :thumbsup:
